Famimaga Disk Vol. 5 - Puyo Puyo.name: Puyo Puyo
Famimaga Disk Vol. 5 - Puyo Puyo.summary: The first game in the popular puzzle series, released one year before the "Action Puzzle Game" arcade title that would turn it into a household name.

Risa no Yousei Densetsu.name: Risa no Yousei Densetsu
Risa no Yousei Densetsu.summary: You take the role of a boy visiting a concert of popular Japanese idol, singer and actress Risa Tachibana. During the concert the sky darkens, lightning strikes and he and Risa get mysteriously transported into a fairy land, which is threatened by an evil witch and her minions. So starts their adventure to overcome the evil witch and find a way back to their own world.
